title: Statement of Account Calculation: Speed Fee Refund on an Order Cancelled Before Dispatch (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
An order cancelled before dispatch under Delivery & Pickup Services has its speed fee refunded in full, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

- **The cancelled order.** The cancelled order concerned is the one most recently cancelled on the plan.
- **The fee refunded.** The fee refunded is the speed fee charged on that order: its express fee for an express order, its same-day fee for a same-day order, as booked against the order on the plan's charge ledger.

## The amount

The refund is the speed fee charged on the cancelled order, never below zero, stated to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical cancelled orders)

| Plan | Cancelled order's speed | Speed fee charged | Refund of the speed fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | same-day | $7.99 | $7.99 |
| Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | express | $12.99 | $12.99 |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | express | $4.99 | $4.99 |

Where two orders were cancelled on the plan, one on 2 June and one on 5 June, the order worked out is the one cancelled on 5 June.
